question: What additional conferment does the teacher declare regarding the staff-bearer?
premises: The teacher speaks in the first person.
A name is associated with the staff.
The name is described as very great.
inference: The teacher declares that he will give another, very great name associated with the staff.
uncertainties: The exact referent of daṇḍinyastaṃ (name placed on the staff-bearer or on the staff) is context-dependent.
plain_english: And I shall give another, very great name associated with the staff.
